{{Quote|You have your lightsaber out, Master. Do you want to fight? I have a lightsaber here&hellip;|[[Malleus|Telloti Cillmam'n]], to [[Ekim Ryelli]]|<ref name="SWI" />}}
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], at the time of the issuance of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] '''duel''' was fought on [[Nicht Ka]] between [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ekim Ryelli]] and [[Malleus|Telloti Cillmam'n]], a member of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Exploration Corps/Legends|ExplorCorps]] who had been [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|corrupted]] by the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] of [[Warb Null]]. At the end of the violent duel, Cillmam'n managed to [[Sai cha/Legends|behead]] Ryelli.<ref name="SWI" />
